//: Production baseline. Override at deploy time: ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection, Ai__Provider, Ai__Endpoint, Ai__Model, Database__AutoMigrate. Never commit credentials, API keys or a production connection string.

Database.//: Migrations are never applied automatically outside Development. Apply them with 'dotnet ef database update' before starting the application.

Security.//: Addresses of the reverse proxies allowed to describe the original request through X-Forwarded-For / X-Forwarded-Proto, e.g. ["127.0.0.1", "10.0.0.0/8"]. Leave empty whenever NETRA is reached directly: forwarded headers are then ignored entirely, and Production serves HTTPS from Kestrel. Set only when TLS terminates in front of NETRA and the instance is not otherwise reachable.

Ai.//: Provider is 'Mock' (deterministic, offline, default) or 'Local' (Ollama-compatible server). Override via environment variables (Ai__Provider, Ai__Endpoint, Ai__Model). Never store API keys here.
